entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
BETWEEN:-
 SANJAY S/O SHRI MANIRAM RAJE, AGED 34 YEARS,
 OCCUPATION: PRIVATE, R/O DEVNAGAR BASTI NAKA  CHANDRAVADNI LASHKAR GWALIOR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI A.K.JAIN-ADVOCATE)
 AND  STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION MADHOGANJ DISTRICT GWALIOR (MADHYA  PRADESH)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER Case diary is available.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as he has been arrested on 13.06.2023 in connection with Crime No.234/2023 registered at Police Station Madhoganj, District Gwalior for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application with liberty to file afresh after filing of charge-sheet.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.
